title: Grade the reply by meaning (failing test first)
goal: The bilingual pack accepts correct paraphrases and refuses wrong ones
acceptance: A committed failing test first: with `exact-json-v1` as released, a correct paraphrase of each of the four cases (Italian and English) fails; the same test must pass after the fix, and a wrong-meaning or wrong-language reply and a wrong `intent` or `language` still fail (pass and fail fixtures per case)

`examples/bilingual-it-en-v1.json` gets the new expectation and a version bump (a released pack: consumers pin the old one), `docs/test-index.md` regenerated, PROTOCOL text updated; no existing test edited to pass
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; no private reports or consumer data.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
